Annotation Interface RequirementTest

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) public @interface RequirementTest

Title: RequirementTest Annotation.

Description: Marks one test method in ContributorRequirementsTestbed and records which Contributor requirement it tests, its number within that requirement, and whether it is a positive test (valid use succeeds) or a negative test (invalid use is refused or handled safely). The testbed runner, the coverage check, and the generated requirements-to-tests list (Task 6 / Task 7.1) all read this annotation, so the list can never drift from the code.
